checks.name: project_files
checks.remediation: Run from a complete Prism checkout.

checks.name: docker_cli
checks.remediation: Install Docker Desktop or another Docker Engine with Compose.

checks.name: docker_daemon
checks.remediation: Start the Docker daemon and confirm the current user can access it.

checks.name: buzz_binaries
checks.remediation: Run python3 scripts/buzz_install_tools.py with network access on the first setup.

checks.name: model_endpoint_loopback
checks.remediation: Use an http://127.0.0.1 or http://localhost LM Studio endpoint.

checks.name: bonsai_model_loaded
checks.remediation: Start LM Studio and load '27b@q1_0'; catalog presence alone is not sufficient.

checks.name: reasoning_off_capability
checks.remediation: Use a loaded model/runtime that advertises the native reasoning-off option.

checks.name: benchmark_deployment_metadata
checks.remediation: Set the PRISM_LOCAL_AI_ARTIFACT_SHA256, RUNTIME, RUNTIME_VERSION, and HARDWARE variables before a benchmark claim.

checks.name: buzz_relay_live
checks.remediation: Run python3 scripts/buzz_up.py and inspect Docker service health.

limitations: This checks the current host only. It does not prove a clean physical machine setup.
A loaded model proves availability, not artifact identity, quality, or performance.
LM Studio API context metadata does not prove the backend's effective fitted context or a workload at that length.
Loopback endpoints do not prove zero egress or an air gap.
Optional deployment metadata is required separately before benchmark claims.
